id: 20_xTool MetalFab Laser Welder 800W - Unboxing and First Use
title: 800瓦手持激光焊机：开箱与首次使用
source_doc: course/Cleanroom & Equipment Safety/20_xTool MetalFab Laser Welder 800W - Unboxing and First Use.md
author_source: project/Cleanroom & Equipment Safety/20_xTool MetalFab Laser Welder 800W - Unboxing and First Use/src.py

points.K4: 放置主机：留间隙，锁脚轮
points.K16: 装焊丝：方向对，线头别松
points.K22: 感应线夹工件，不夹焊枪

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实训车间里一个大纸箱旁，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands next to a large blank cardboard box in a university training workshop and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课，从开箱到第一次焊接。
overlay: 手持激光焊接机开箱、安装与首次使用

shots.scene: 三个图标：焊缝、清洗刷、切割火花
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in a row: a weld seam, a cleaning brush with sparkles and a cutting spark. No people.
shots.narration: 这台焊机能焊接、能清洗、也能切割。

shots.scene: 阿杰站在一个大纸箱前，两眼放光
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stands in front of a large blank cardboard box in a workshop, looking excited.
shots.narration: 实验室新到了一台手持激光焊机。

shots.scene: 老李拿着空白快速指南走过来，拍拍纸箱
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer walks over holding a blank quick start guide and pats the box.
shots.narration: 老李说：照着步骤，一步一步来。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起一根手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 开箱、安装、使用、维护，跟我走。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在纸箱和焊机图标之间，中间一个箭头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands between a cardboard box icon and a welding machine icon joined by an arrow.
shots.narration: 我们按步骤来：开箱、安装、送丝、使用。

shots.scene: 老李打开箱盖，取出快速指南和安全须知
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer opens the box lid and takes out a blank quick start guide and a blank safety instruction booklet.
shots.narration: 先取出快速指南和安全须知。

shots.scene: 台面上整齐摆着眼镜盒、几个喷嘴、备用镜片、钥匙、U盘、几块试板和一盘焊丝
shots.prompt_en: Laid out neatly on a bench: a goggles case, several nozzles, spare lens pieces, a key, a USB stick, a few metal test plates and a wire spool. No people.
shots.narration: 还有1080纳米防护眼镜、喷嘴和钥匙。

shots.scene: 焊机从箱子里抬出，去掉包装袋
shots.prompt_en: The welding machine is lifted out of the box and its plastic bag is removed.
shots.narration: 取出主机，去掉包装袋。

shots.scene: 焊机背面板和打开的侧门里送丝机的示意，标注转盘和送丝轮
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of the machine's back panel and the open side door showing the wire spool holder and the wire feeding rollers. No people.
shots.narration: 认识背面板，和侧门里的送丝机。

shots.section_title: 放置主机：留间隙，锁脚轮
shots.scene: 焊机前后两端到墙之间画着绿色虚线间隙
shots.prompt_en: Green dotted lines mark the clear gaps between the front and back of the machine and the walls. No people.
shots.narration: 主机前后各留10厘米以上。
overlay: 放置主机：留间隙，锁脚轮

shots.section_title: 放置主机：留间隙，锁脚轮
shots.scene: 老李踩下脚轮刹车
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer presses down the brake on a caster wheel with his foot.
shots.narration: 放好后锁住四个脚轮。

shots.scene: 示意图：焊机背面接一根蓝色气管到固定好的气瓶
shots.prompt_en: A diagram: a blue gas tube runs from the back of the welding machine to a gas cylinder. No people.
shots.narration: 连接保护气。

shots.scene: 气管一头插进主机背面入口，另一头接到气瓶流量计
shots.prompt_en: One end of the blue tube is pushed into the gas inlet on the back of the machine; the other end is connected to the flow meter on the cylinder.
shots.narration: 一头插主机入口，一头接气瓶或制气机。

shots.scene: 老李用小内六角拧螺钉，把两个托架装到底板上
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer uses a small hex key to screw two cradle arms onto a flat base plate.
shots.narration: 用随附的2.5毫米内六角组装支架。

shots.scene: 焊枪平稳地放在支架上
shots.prompt_en: The welding gun rests steadily on the assembled cradle. No people.
shots.narration: 焊枪放在支架上。

shots.scene: 老李把带夹子的感应线插头插进前面板端口
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer plugs the connector of a sensing cable with a clamp into a port on the front panel.
shots.narration: 把工件感应线插到前面板。

shots.scene: 电源线和铭牌特写，铭牌上只有闪电和接地符号
shots.prompt_en: Close view of the power cable and a nameplate showing only a lightning bolt and an earth symbol.
shots.narration: 输入220到240伏交流，额定3000瓦。

shots.scene: 电流表图标和一段回路示意
shots.prompt_en: An ammeter icon next to a simple diagram of a single electrical circuit. No people.
shots.narration: 满载13.5安，回路载流20安以上。

shots.scene: 专用插座带接地符号，旁边空白标签
shots.prompt_en: A dedicated wall socket with an earth symbol and a blank label. No people.
shots.narration: 建议独立回路，电源必须接地。

shots.scene: 老李在打开的配电箱前接线
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer connects cables in an open distribution box with a screwdriver.
shots.narration: 接法各异，硬接线由专业电工来做。

shots.scene: 红色急停按钮特写，手指轻转使其弹起
shots.prompt_en: Close view of the red emergency stop button as a finger twists it so it pops up.
shots.narration: 开机前，确认急停按钮已经松开。

shots.scene: 钥匙插进前面板的钥匙口
shots.prompt_en: A key is inserted into the key port on the front panel.
shots.narration: 把钥匙插进指定端口。

shots.scene: 打开背面电源开关，屏幕亮起
shots.prompt_en: The rocker switch on the back panel is turned on and the touch screen lights up.
shots.narration: 打开背面开关开机。

shots.scene: 触摸屏上选择语言和单位，界面空白
shots.prompt_en: A finger taps blank options on the touch screen to choose a language and units.
shots.narration: 在屏幕上选语言和单位。

shots.scene: 屏幕显示一个二维码图标，小研用手机扫码
shots.prompt_en: The screen shows a QR code icon and the female graduate student scans it with a blank phone.
shots.narration: 第一次开机，屏幕会出现二维码。

shots.scene: 手机上播放安全培训视频，小研认真看
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student watches a safety training video on her phone attentively.
shots.narration: 扫码看完安全培训视频。

shots.scene: 屏幕上输入空白密码框，设备解锁
shots.prompt_en: A blank password box on the touch screen is filled and the device unlocks with a green check.
shots.narration: 用序列号换取密码，才能解锁设备。

shots.scene: 屏幕系统设置里一个空白参考值，焊枪上的刻度管特写
shots.prompt_en: A blank reference value on the system settings screen next to a close view of the graduated tube on the welding gun.
shots.narration: 校准焦距：对比屏幕参考值和刻度管。

shots.scene: 松开扣件，推拉刻度管对准参考值
shots.prompt_en: The fastener is opened and the graduated tube is pushed or pulled to match the reference mark.
shots.narration: 一致就不用调，不一致就推拉对准。

shots.scene: 打开侧门和送丝驱动，拆下螺钉
shots.prompt_en: The side door and the wire feeder cover are opened and the roller screws are removed.
shots.narration: 打开送丝驱动，拆下螺钉。

shots.scene: 装上与焊丝直径匹配的送丝轮，螺钉装回
shots.prompt_en: Drive rollers matching the wire diameter are fitted and the screws are put back.
shots.narration: 按焊丝粗细装上送丝轮。

shots.scene: 送丝管的一端插入送丝驱动右侧
shots.prompt_en: One end of the wire feeding tube is inserted into the right side of the wire feeder.
shots.narration: 送丝管插到送丝驱动右侧。

shots.scene: 喷嘴顶住右侧板，拧紧螺钉
shots.prompt_en: The tube nozzle is pushed until it touches the right plate and the screw is tightened.
shots.narration: 顶到底，拧紧螺钉固定。

shots.section_title: 装焊丝：方向对，线头别松
shots.scene: 焊丝盘装到转盘上，箭头示意焊丝从盘底部出来
shots.prompt_en: A wire spool is mounted on the holder, with an arrow showing the wire coming off from the bottom of the spool. No people.
shots.narration: 焊丝盘方向要装对。
overlay: 装焊丝：方向对，线头别松

shots.section_title: 装焊丝：方向对，线头别松
shots.scene: 小研一手捏住线头，焊丝盘松开散乱的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student firmly pinches the wire end; an icon of a spool unraveling is crossed out with a red X.
shots.narration: 捏住线头别松手，不然会散开。

shots.section_title: 装焊丝：方向对，线头别松
shots.scene: 钳子剪掉焊丝弯头，焊丝穿过送丝轮
shots.prompt_en: Pliers cut off the bent end of the wire, and the wire is threaded through the drive rollers.
shots.narration: 剪掉弯头，穿过送丝轮进送丝管。

shots.scene: 合上两个红色压紧臂，旋动旋钮，旁边空白表格
shots.prompt_en: Two red tensioner arms are closed and their knobs are turned, next to a blank table.
shots.narration: 合上压紧臂，按表调压紧力。

shots.scene: 屏幕送丝控制界面，手指按住送丝键
shots.prompt_en: A finger presses and holds the feed button on a blank wire feed control screen.
shots.narration: 在屏幕送丝控制里按住送丝。

shots.scene: 焊丝从喷嘴伸出一小段，手指松开；旁边回抽箭头
shots.prompt_en: The wire extends a little from the nozzle and the finger releases; a retract arrow icon is beside it.
shots.narration: 伸出喷嘴就停，太长就回抽。

shots.scene: 送丝管的扣件套到焊枪头上，焊丝从喷嘴槽伸出
shots.prompt_en: The fastener of the wire feeding tube slides onto the gun tip, and the wire comes out through the groove of the nozzle.
shots.narration: 送丝管装到焊枪头，焊丝走喷嘴槽。

shots.scene: 扣紧扣件，固定送丝管，焊枪放回支架
shots.prompt_en: The fastener is closed, the tube is clipped along the gun, and the gun is placed back on its cradle.
shots.narration: 扣紧、固定，焊枪放回支架。

shots.scene: 小研戴激光防护眼镜、焊接面罩、防尘口罩、耐热手套、防护服和围裙
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student puts on laser safety goggles, a welding face shield, a dust mask, heat-resistant gloves, protective clothing and an apron.
shots.narration: 开焊前，按安全须知穿戴防护用品。

shots.scene: 排风罩开着，气流箭头从工位抽走
shots.prompt_en: An extraction hood is running above the welding table, with airflow arrows drawing fumes away. No people.
shots.narration: 工作间要通风良好。

shots.scene: 气瓶上装着流量计，屏幕上允许出光为关
shots.prompt_en: A flow meter is fitted on the gas cylinder; the touch screen shows the laser enable switch turned off.
shots.narration: 气瓶装好流量计，先确认不允许出光。

shots.scene: 打开瓶阀，按住焊枪按键通气，旋钮调流量
shots.prompt_en: The cylinder valve is opened; the gun buttons are held to let gas flow while the flow knob is adjusted.
shots.narration: 开瓶阀通气，流量调到每分钟15到30升。

shots.section_title: 感应线夹工件，不夹焊枪
shots.scene: 工件放在金属底座上，感应线夹子夹在工件边上
shots.prompt_en: A workpiece rests on a metal base and the sensing cable clamp is clipped onto the workpiece edge.
shots.narration: 工件放金属底座，感应线夹在工件上。
overlay: 感应线夹工件，不夹焊枪

shots.section_title: 感应线夹工件，不夹焊枪
shots.scene: 夹子夹在焊枪刻度管上的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of the sensing clamp clipped onto the graduated tube of the welding gun, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 严禁把夹子夹在焊枪上。

shots.scene: 焊丝端头和地面上的红色指示光点重合
shots.prompt_en: Close view of the wire tip touching exactly the small red aiming dot on the metal. No people.
shots.narration: 用送丝回抽键，让焊丝尖对准红光点。

shots.scene: 红光点偏在焊丝一侧、模糊的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of the red dot shifted to one side of the wire and blurred, with a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 红光偏了或看不清，先校准。

shots.scene: 焊枪上的送丝使能开关拨到开
shots.prompt_en: The wire feeding enable switch on the welding gun is flipped to on.
shots.narration: 打开焊枪上的送丝使能开关。

shots.scene: 屏幕上选材料、厚度、焊丝直径，再点允许送丝和允许出光，界面空白
shots.prompt_en: A finger taps blank options for material, thickness and wire diameter on the screen, then taps two enable buttons.
shots.narration: 选好材料厚度和焊丝，再允许送丝出光。

shots.scene: 小研对准起点，按住握持键和扳机，焊点发光
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student aims at the start point and holds the grip button and trigger; the weld spot glows.
shots.narration: 对准起点，按住握持键和扳机。

shots.scene: 先点焊两端，再沿缝连续焊
shots.prompt_en: Two small tack welds appear at both ends of the seam, then a continuous weld bead runs along it. No people.
shots.narration: 先点焊起止点，再连续焊。

shots.scene: 焊枪被轻轻往后推，小研稳住引导方向，往下压的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: The gun is gently pushed back by the feed; the female graduate student steadies it, and an icon of pressing the gun down is crossed out.
shots.narration: 稳住焊枪引方向，不往下压，免得粘丝。

shots.scene: 刚焊完的工件和焊枪头冒着热浪
shots.prompt_en: The freshly welded workpiece and the gun tip give off heat waves. No people.
shots.narration: 焊完的工件和焊枪头都很烫。

shots.scene: 屏幕关闭允许送丝和允许出光
shots.prompt_en: A finger turns off the two enable buttons on the touch screen.
shots.narration: 无防护别碰，关闭送丝和出光。

shots.scene: 关机后拆下送丝管和焊接嘴，换上清洗嘴
shots.prompt_en: With the machine off, the wire feeding tube and the welding nozzle are removed and a cleaning nozzle is fitted.
shots.narration: 激光清洗：先关机，换上清洗嘴。

shots.scene: 开机选清洗，焊枪沿焊缝方向移动，表面变亮
shots.prompt_en: After switching on and choosing cleaning, the gun moves along the direction of the weld seam and the surface turns bright.
shots.narration: 开机选清洗，沿焊缝方向移动。

shots.scene: 记下屏幕参考值，关机换上切割嘴并对准参考值
shots.prompt_en: A blank reference value is noted from the screen; the machine is switched off and a cutting tip is fitted and set to the reference mark.
shots.narration: 激光切割：关机换切割嘴，对准参考值。

shots.scene: 气瓶上的流量计换成双表减压阀
shots.prompt_en: The flow meter on the cylinder is replaced with a two-gauge pressure regulator.
shots.narration: 气瓶的流量计换成减压阀。

shots.scene: 开机看红光：清晰圆点打勾，散开的光线打叉
shots.prompt_en: Two views of the aiming light: a clear round red dot with a green check and a scattered red line with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 红光要清晰完整，不然先校准防烧嘴。

shots.scene: 手转动减压阀手柄，压力表指针移动
shots.prompt_en: Close view of a hand turning the regulator knob while the needle on a blank gauge moves.
shots.narration: 气压调到0.6到0.8兆帕。

shots.scene: 选材料厚度，切割火花向下飞溅
shots.prompt_en: After choosing material and thickness, the cut throws sparks downward from the metal sheet.
shots.narration: 选好材料厚度，开始切割。

shots.scene: 两个不同大小的送丝嘴并排，旁边对照表空白
shots.prompt_en: Two wire feeding nozzles of different sizes side by side, with a blank matching table. No people.
shots.narration: 送丝嘴按焊丝粗细更换。

shots.scene: 焊接火花变弱的对比图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon comparing a strong weld spark and a weak weld spark, with a downward arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 功率下降、火花变弱，查保护镜。

shots.scene: 在干净台面上，小研戴蓝色无尘手套，打开焊枪顶盖
shots.prompt_en: On a clean bench, the female graduate student wearing blue lint-free gloves opens the top cover of the welding gun.
shots.narration: 在洁净处，戴无尘手套打开顶盖。

shots.scene: 取出最靠近喷嘴的保护镜，用棉签轻擦
shots.prompt_en: The lens protector closest to the nozzle is taken out and gently wiped with a cotton swab.
shots.narration: 脏了用酒精棉签擦净。

shots.scene: 烧黑的镜片图标打叉，换上新镜片，手指不碰镜面
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a burned lens crossed out; a new lens is installed holding only its edges, fingers never touching the glass.
shots.narration: 烧坏擦不净就换新的，手别碰镜面。

shots.scene: 撕掉保护膜，按正确方向装回压到位
shots.prompt_en: The protective films are peeled off and the lens holder is pressed back in the correct direction.
shots.narration: 撕掉保护膜，方向装对，压到位。

shots.scene: 焊丝和红光点左右错开，屏幕上左右箭头
shots.prompt_en: The red dot sits beside the wire; the blank screen shows left and right arrows.
shots.narration: 红光左右偏，在设置里调偏移。

shots.scene: 老李在触摸屏前，屏幕上锁形图标和空白小键盘
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer stands at the touch screen, which shows a padlock icon and a blank keypad.
shots.narration: 进管理员设置，红点落在焊丝上点完成。

shots.scene: 内六角插进焊枪背面的调节孔，红光变成清晰圆点
shots.prompt_en: A small hex key is inserted into an adjustment hole on the back of the gun, and the red light becomes a clear round dot.
shots.narration: 还不行就归零，用2毫米内六角调上下。

shots.scene: 细丝盘箭头指向粗丝盘
shots.prompt_en: A thin wire spool with an arrow pointing to a thicker wire spool. No people.
shots.narration: 以1毫米换1.2毫米焊丝为例。

shots.scene: 回抽焊丝，把线头塞进焊丝盘边的小孔
shots.prompt_en: The wire is retracted and its end is tucked into the small hole on the spool rim.
shots.narration: 回抽焊丝，线头塞进盘孔。

shots.scene: 取下旧盘，装上新的焊丝盘
shots.prompt_en: The old spool is removed and a new wire spool is mounted.
shots.narration: 装上新盘，再按前面步骤送丝调压。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在装好的焊机旁，身边浮现纸箱、气管、插头图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside the installed laser welding machine; icons of a box, a gas tube and a power plug float beside it.
shots.narration: 开箱清点，接好气、电和感应线。

shots.scene: 欣欣身边浮现急停、钥匙、二维码、刻度管图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points to floating icons of an emergency stop button, a key, a square code pattern and a graduated tube.
shots.narration: 松急停插钥匙，看培训解锁，核焦距。

shots.scene: 欣欣身边浮现焊接、清洗、切割三个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points to three icons: a weld seam, a cleaning spark and a cutting line.
shots.narration: 穿好防护，焊接、清洗、切割。

shots.scene: 欣欣手拿一片镜片和一个内六角扳手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a small round lens and a tiny hex key.
shots.narration: 换送丝嘴、清保护镜、校红光、换焊丝。

shots.scene: 欣欣、老李、小研和阿杰在新焊机前挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot, the facility engineer, the female graduate student and the young male student wave goodbye in front of the new laser welding machine.
shots.narration: 新焊机用起来了，下次见！
